leads.query:
with membership as (
  select campaign_id, person_id, min(add_to_target_date) as added_at
  from person_in_campaigns_history
  where campaign_id is not null and person_id is not null
  group by campaign_id, person_id
),
pei as (
  select person_id, external_id from (
    select person_id, external_id,
           row_number() over (partition by person_id
             order by (external_id like 'AC%'), rowid desc) as rn
    from person_external_ids
    where type_group = 'public'
  ) where rn = 1
),
invites as (
  select a.campaign_id, ar.person_id, min(ar.created_at) as invited_at
  from action_results ar
  join action_versions av on av.id = ar.action_version_id
  join actions a on a.id = av.action_id
  join action_configs ac on ac.id = av.config_id
  where ac.actionType = 'InvitePerson' and cast(ar.result as text) = '1'
  group by a.campaign_id, ar.person_id
),
connections as (
  select person_id, min(connected_at) as connected_at
  from person_connect
  where connected_at is not null
  group by person_id
),
replies as (
  select a.campaign_id, ar.person_id, min(ar.created_at) as replied_at
  from action_result_messages arm
  join action_results ar on ar.id = arm.action_result_id
  join action_versions av on av.id = ar.action_version_id
  join actions a on a.id = av.action_id
  where arm.type = 'Replied'
  group by a.campaign_id, ar.person_id
),
last_actions as (
  select a.campaign_id, ar.person_id, max(ar.created_at) as last_action_at
  from action_results ar
  join action_versions av on av.id = ar.action_version_id
  join actions a on a.id = av.action_id
  group by a.campaign_id, ar.person_id
)
select m.campaign_id as campaign_id,
       'https://www.linkedin.com/in/' || pei.external_id as profile_url,
       pmp.full_name as full_name,
       pmp.headline as headline,
       m.added_at as added_at,
       i.invited_at as invited_at,
       c.connected_at as connected_at,
       r.replied_at as replied_at,
       la.last_action_at as last_action_at
from membership m
join pei on pei.person_id = m.person_id
left join person_original_mini_profile pmp on pmp.person_id = m.person_id
left join invites i on i.campaign_id = m.campaign_id and i.person_id = m.person_id
left join connections c on c.person_id = m.person_id
left join replies r on r.campaign_id = m.campaign_id and r.person_id = m.person_id
left join last_actions la on la.campaign_id = m.campaign_id and la.person_id = m.person_id
leads.headline: headline

owner.query: select full_name as name, avatar as avatar_url from li_accounts limit 1
owner.name: name
